error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
error.not_ready: The server cannot reach its database just now.
error.invalid_body: The request could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
error.unsupported_body: The request was sent in a form this server does not accept.
error.body_too_large: The request is larger than this server accepts.
error.cross_site: Requests from other sites are not allowed.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.super_admin_only: Only a super admin can do that.
error.language_code_taken: There is already a language with this code.
error.language_copy_missing: There is no language {code} to copy.
error.language_default_required: Make another language the default rather than unmarking this one.
error.language_default_protected: Make another language the default before removing this one.
error.language_base_protected: English is what every other language falls back to, so it stays.
error.translation_app_not_found: There is no such part of the product to translate.
error.translation_too_long: The text of {key} must be at most {max} characters.
error.sso_unreachable: A connection without domains has to show its button on the sign-in page, and cannot be required: no address leads to it.
error.sso_link_needs_domains: Only a connection with domains can link to existing accounts: list the domains it answers for, or set it to refuse addresses that already have an account.
error.sso_domain_not_listed: This connection does not list that domain.
error.sso_slug_taken: Another connection already uses the identifier {slug}.
error.sso_issuer_invalid: The issuer must be an https address.
error.sso_discovery_failed: The issuer's discovery document could not be read: {reason}
error.sso_metadata_invalid: The SAML metadata could not be used: {reason}
error.sso_role_unknown: A mapping names a role that does not exist.
error.sso_role_mapping_invalid: Every mapping needs a group and a role.
error.session_not_found: That session has ended or never existed.
error.mail_test_needs_recipient: Say where the test message should go.
error.mail_test_failed: The mail server did not take the message: {reason}
error.mail_content_key_unknown: {key} is not part of any email this server sends.
error.admin_wrong_password: Your current password is not right.
error.admin_avatar_invalid: The avatar must be a full address starting with http:// or https://.
error.admin_session_current: That is the session you are using. Sign out to end it.
error.admin_session_not_found: There is no such session of yours.
error.logs_filter_invalid: These filters cannot be applied. Check the dates and try again.
error.admin_email_taken: An administrator with this email already exists.
error.admin_password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters.
error.admin_password_breached: That password is known from a data breach, so it is among the first anybody would try. Choose another.
error.redis_not_configured: This server runs without Redis, so there is no cache to look after.
error.cache_database_not_found: There is no such Redis database.
error.cache_group_not_found: There is no such cache group.
error.cache_key_not_found: That key is not in Redis any more.
error.cache_key_not_editable: Only a cached value in the cache database can be edited.
error.cache_generation_key: A generation counter cannot be removed. Clear its group instead.
error.cache_key_invalid: That is not a key name.
error.cache_kind_invalid: There is no such kind of key.
error.cache_cursor_invalid: The listing could not be continued. Start it again.
error.cache_value_invalid: The value has to be valid JSON.
error.cache_ttl_invalid: The time to live has to be between 0 and {max} seconds.
error.token_refused: This access token is not accepted by the admin API: it has expired, is for another API, is not a service's token, or its application has lost access.
error.system_api: This API is part of the server and cannot be deleted.
error.system_api_access: Only a super admin can give an application access to the server's own APIs, or take it away.
error.system_application: admin-cli is part of the server and cannot be deleted. Turn it off instead.
error.system_application_change: Only a super admin can change an application that has access to the admin API, or rotate its secret.
error.social_provider_repointed: This provider already has linked accounts, so it cannot be pointed at a different one. Register a new provider instead.
error.api_identifier_fixed: An API's identifier cannot be changed: register a new API instead.
error.api_identifier_taken: An API with this identifier already exists.
error.api_too_many_scopes: An API may have at most {max} scopes.
error.api_scope_foreign: {scope} is not a scope of this API.
error.admin_sign_in_expired: Your sign-in has expired. Enter your password again.
error.admin_sign_in_code_wrong: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
error.setup_done: This panel has already been set up.
error.admin_no_passkeys: This account has no passkey. Use a code from your authenticator app instead.
error.mfa_passkey_limit: You have as many passkeys as you may add. Remove one first.
error.mfa_passkey_refused: The passkey's answer was not accepted. Try again, or use another passkey.
error.mfa_passkey_not_found: There is no such passkey on your account.
error.admin_idle_timeout_out_of_range: The idle timeout must be between {min} and {max} minutes.
error.setup_token_invalid: That setup token is not valid. Use the one the server wrote to its log when it started; restarting the server writes a new one.
error.admin_role_not_found: There is no such admin role.
error.admin_role_built_in: super_admin is built in and cannot be changed or removed.
error.admin_role_name_taken: An admin role with this name already exists.
error.user_role_application_unknown: The role's application does not exist.
error.user_role_name_taken: A role with this name already exists in this scope.
error.admin_own_mfa: You cannot reset your own two-factor sign-in here. Manage it from your profile.
error.admin_own_account: You cannot delete your own account.
error.mfa_code_wrong: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
error.mfa_not_enrolling: Start setting up an authenticator first.
error.mfa_enabled: Two-factor sign-in is already on. Give a code from your current authenticator to replace it.
error.mfa_required: Two-factor sign-in is required for every administrator and cannot be turned off. Replace your authenticator instead.
error.social_provider_slug_taken: A provider with this identifier already exists.
error.social_provider_secret_missing: There is no secret stored for this provider.
error.social_provider_kind_invalid: The kind must be one of: {kinds}.
error.user_social_account_not_found: This user does not sign in with that.
error.user_roles_missing: Name at least one role to assign.
error.user_role_unknown: One of the roles does not exist.
error.user_role_not_held: The user was not given that role directly.
error.user_email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
error.user_password_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters.
error.user_password_breached: That password is known from a data breach, so it is among the first anybody would try. Choose another.
error.admin_role_name_reserved: super_admin is built in. Choose another name.
error.admin_own_access: You cannot suspend yourself or take away your own super_admin role.
error.admin_assignment_role_unknown: One of the roles to assign does not exist.
error.admin_assignment_application_unknown: One of the applications to assign a role for does not exist.
error.admin_assignment_super_admin_scoped: super_admin can only be held for the whole panel.
error.user_field_built_in: {name} is a built-in field: every record has one already, and two fields with one name would be two places to look.
error.mail_content_too_long: {key} is longer than a message may be.
error.user_role_inherits_unknown: One of the roles to include does not exist.
error.user_role_inherits_forbidden: Your roles do not allow you to include {role}.
error.user_role_inherits_foreign: {role} belongs to another application. An application role can include global roles and its own application's roles.
error.user_role_inherits_cycle: A role cannot include itself, or a role that includes it.
error.user_role_api_scopes_forbidden: Your roles do not allow you to see APIs.
error.user_role_api_scope_unknown: One of the API scopes does not exist.
error.user_password_temporary_without_password: A password can only be temporary once one is set.
error.application_type_fixed: An application's type cannot be changed: register a new application instead.
error.application_no_secret: A public client has no secret to rotate.
error.application_api_scope_foreign: One of the scopes is not a scope of {api}.
error.token_preview_user_unknown: There is no such user to preview a token for.
error.application_too_many_uris: An application may have at most {max} redirect URIs of each kind.
error.application_type_invalid: The type must be one of: web, spa, native, m2m.
error.application_login_flow_unknown: There is no such login flow.
error.user_field_name_taken: A field with this name already exists.
error.login_flow_slug_taken: A flow with this identifier already exists.
error.login_flow_default_required: Make another flow the default rather than unmarking this one.
error.login_flow_default_protected: Make another flow the default before removing this one.
error.login_flow_not_found: There is no such login flow.
error.organization_logo_too_large: The logo is larger than 512 KB. Use a smaller file.
error.organization_logo_type: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG file.
error.organization_logo_dimensions: The logo must be between 16 and 4096 pixels on each side.
